title: Managed Backup: resource capacity
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines resource capacity.

## Tier basis

**Resource count limit.** Maximum provisioned resource count in one holding; integer.

| Contract tier | Resource count limit |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | 64 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | 64 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | 64 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | 64 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | 64 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | 64 |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, resource count limit is 64.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, resource count limit stays the same.
